title: Security baseline and Memory 2.0
description: Server-authoritative dialogue, bounded provider transport, episodic Memory 2.0, semantic FACT/BELIEF, relationships and world-local persistence became one protected architecture.

title: Operator Lore S9–S10c
description: World, player, villager and village lore received immutable AI-context integration, a server-authoritative revision API and a dedicated operator-only client editor.

title: Installed failures became release gates
description: 0.1.20 ended as a partial PASS with water, grave, identity and latency defects. 0.1.21 then failed at startup on a production-unsafe tombstone Mixin; safe rollback preserved persistent data and restored service.

title: M11 automated production acceptance completed
description: PRs #103–#112 established the risk catalogue, real Fabric GameTests, exact production-JAR startup/restart, tombstone inventory ownership, deterministic provider clients, one shared voice-turn deadline and bounded concurrency automation. Installed/manual evidence remains a separate layer.

title: 0.2.0 Memory 2.0 clean cutover released and installed
description: The official 0.2.0+1.21.1 release moved persistent dialogue to Memory 2.0-only storage. The byte-identical installed candidate completed the required clean-world suite at 7 PASS / 0 FAIL; VAI-M2-INST-005 remains NOT TESTED / automated evidence only and VAI-CONCUR-004 remains NOT TESTED / DEFERRED.

title: Controlled Semantic Memory BELIEF admission accepted
description: PR #123 added a provenance-safe BELIEF admission contract: PLAYER_TOLD, NPC_TOLD and INFERRED remain non-authoritative beliefs tied to persisted source evidence; SYSTEM_OBSERVED cannot enter through the BELIEF API and FACT remains server-observed only.

title: Bounded PLAYER_TOLD BELIEF candidate extraction — Draft/RED
description: PR #125 is the current TDD slice. It proposes bounded PLAYER_TOLD statement candidates inside the existing structured chat response without a second provider request. The server still owns provenance, NPC/player/source identity and admission; the current Draft/RED state is development evidence and not accepted product truth.

title: Make bounded BELIEF extraction green without weakening authority
description: Complete the PR #125 RED→GREEN contract for successful, empty, malformed and retry cases; prove fail-soft provider behavior and exactly-once semantic persistence; preserve current observed FACT over conflicting BELIEF. Only after that move to trustworthy causal relationship reasons and longer-horizon memory work.
